summary: Bind cursor pagination to the cursor query parameter across the generated pagination tables and promoted list commands.
reason: Generator cursor detection selected the unrelated 'after' ISO-datetime filter and left cursorParam empty on routes whose only pagination params are cursor and limit, so page two of every list route failed with 400 errors/invalid_parameters.
validated_outcome: A full live sync went from failing on page two of every resource to 20 resources and 21,612 records with zero errors.
